g.text: Provisional IDs 21-26. Termination is present only at the controller and far physical ends; biasing belongs to the selected transceiver implementation.

g.desc: Provisional IDs 21-26. Termination is present only at the controller and far physical ends; biasing belongs to the selected transceiver implementation.

g.text: 08 HR-30 right leg: six individually fused actuators and one linear RS-485 bus

g.desc: 08 HR-30 right leg: six individually fused actuators and one linear RS-485 bus

g.text: NOTE 1: D+/D- must be routed as a controlled twisted pair. Shield/drain termination and chassis strategy are SELECTION REQUIRED.

g.desc: NOTE 1: D+/D- must be routed as a controlled twisted pair. Shield/drain termination and chassis strategy are SELECTION REQUIRED.

g.text: NOTE 2: Power conductors are separately injected and routed away from the data pair; cable separation dimensions require harness review.

g.desc: NOTE 2: Power conductors are separately injected and routed away from the data pair; cable separation dimensions require harness review.

g.text: NOTE 3: Standard fully populated 4-pin RS-485 DYNAMIXEL cables carry VDD and would parallel protected branches. Release a VDD-isolating harness/breakout and pass continuity plus no-backfeed tests.

g.desc: NOTE 3: Standard fully populated 4-pin RS-485 DYNAMIXEL cables carry VDD and would parallel protected branches. Release a VDD-isolating harness/breakout and pass continuity plus no-backfeed tests.
